title: Mexican Spring Pasta Delight
description: A vibrant and zesty Mexican-inspired pasta dish showcasing the sweetness of spring and the tanginess of Italian flavors.

ingredients.name: spring pasta
ingredients.notes: such as fettuccine or angel hair

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the Italian olive oil over medium heat.
Add the yellowed onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add the sliced leek and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until tender.
Stir in the Mexican cumin powder and cook for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the leek mixture.
Toss everything together until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
